text:
Geelani replaced Maulvi Umar Farooq as APHC chairman in 1998, not 2003; the team note likely conflates this with the September 2003 split, when Geelani led a separate APHC (G) faction ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syed_Ali_Shah_Geelani), [Wikipedia APHC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_Parties_Hurriyat_Conference)). Geelani's infobox lists his APHC term as 1998 to 20 July 2000, preceded by Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, and I didn't open the pages to confirm it beyond the search summary. The 1998 date is consistent across the sources I found, but the search summaries are not a full read of the articles.

CONFIDENCE: 75
